set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /tmp/fixture-home

bun -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({version:Bun.version,arch:process.arch,platform:process.platform}))' > /evidence/process.json
/release/duet --help > /evidence/help.txt
bun -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const help=await Bun.file("/evidence/help.txt").text(); assert(help.includes("(disposable predecessor)")); console.log("PASS source-built predecessor help marker");'
